subject: BrightPath Hosted API — Request for executive authorization of non-standard rate
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Santos <olivia.santos@brightpathlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Proposal and pricing — BrightPath Hosted API pilot

Hi Olivia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great to see BrightPath's ingestion pipeline and how you plan to use embeddings + chat for clinician workflows. Per our conversation I attached a 12-month pilot proposal and a month-by-month forecast.

Key proposed terms (summary):
- Hosted API tier: 2M tokens/month baseline; auto-scale for burst usage
- Standard list price: $0.0045 /k token (hosted generation)
- Provisional commercial concession requested by customer: 28% off list for 12-month commitment
- Estimated committed ARR (net): $182k/year after concession

Attachments: BrightPath_Monthly_Forecast.xlsx, SOW-Draft.pdf

Olivia — I flagged the 28% above for internal approval (our standard threshold for sales-managed concessions is 20%). If you can confirm the usage cadence and whether procurement wants prepay vs monthly invoicing, I can start the internal approval thread today.

Next steps:
- Confirm prepay vs invoicing preference by 12/13
- If prepay, confirm payment schedule and PO number

Happy to hop on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Olivia Santos <olivia.santos@brightpathlabs.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightpathlabs.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Proposal and pricing — BrightPath Hosted API pilot

Ben,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the forecast. The numbers look in the right ballpark, but procurement is pushing for a deeper concession — they're asking if you can get to 35% off list for a 12-month commitment paid up front. The reasons they cited: they have a competing vendor with a locked-in discount, and BrightPath expects a large ramp (we want price stability).

Also, they asked for an SLA addendum and SOC 2 evidence as part of the signature packet. I've attached the RFP excerpt with procurement comments.

Can you escalate the 35% ask? If 35% is off the table, would Redwood consider 30% if we extend commitment to 18 months and prepay?

Attachments: BrightPath_RFP.pdf

Thanks,
Olivia Santos
Director, Platform Engineering | BrightPath Labs
olivia.santos@brightpathlabs.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 10:20:00 -0000
Subject: Fwd: BrightPath Hosted API — escalation request for >20% concession (DL-2026-0098)

Team,

Forwarding the thread with BrightPath. They pushed back requesting 35% for a 12-month prepay, or alternatively 30% if they extend to 18 months and prepay.

Quick context and economics:
- Forecasted committed usage: 2M tokens/month baseline; expected ramp to 3.5M tokens/month by month 6
- Net ARR at list: ~$252k for 12 months; at 30% concession net ARR drops to ~$176k
- Gross margin estimate (cloud + infra): ~28% at list; drops to ~14% at 30% concession (after estimated infra costs)
- Strategic value: BrightPath is a healthcare platform with potential to standardize on Redwood for patient-facing triage workflows. They asked explicitly for SOC2 and data residency language (US-only).

Ask: Exec authorization to offer up to 30% concession for DL-2026-0098 conditioned on:
1) 12- or 18-month prepaid commitment (prefer prepaid, but 18-month acceptable)
2) Addendum for SOC2 evidence and US data residency clause in SOW
3) Legal to include standard fallback: Redwood can revert to list pricing on renewal if consumption materially deviates (>40% under-commitment)

If we approve 30% for 18 months (prepay), estimated net ARR is acceptable for team-level quota credit; 35% would push margin too close to cost.

I've attached the forecast and draft SOW for reference.

Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightPath Hosted API — escalation request for >20% concession (DL-2026-0098)

Ben / Laura,

Thanks for the clear economic breakdown. Approve offering a 30% concession under these strict conditions:
- 18-month prepaid commitment preferred; if customer insists on 12 months, require an additional two-month trial premium (effectively slightly higher first payment) to protect gross margin
- Legal to include SOC2 attestation references and US-only data residency clause in the SOW addendum
- Include renewal floor: pricing cannot be re-negotiated below 85% of list on renewal without VP-level signoff

Please work with Legal to draft the concession memo and SOW addendum (cc me on the DocuSign packet). Once we have procurement confirmation of prepayment and PO number, I will sign the exec concession memo.

Marcus Lin
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

>

>
> Ben
